verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM ships an official MCP server that works with Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients. It can query records across standard and custom modules via COQL, and the REST API can fetch records and related lists. An agent can therefore pull open deals and account data before a meeting, but the evidence never shows access to email or activity history. missing for 10: documented retrieval of recent emails and activity/timeline history via API or MCP, an end-to-end account-brief example, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Zoho CRM MCP servers work with any AI tool that supports MCP, including Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and Windsurf.
Query records across standard and custom modules using COQL
This allows you to perform CRM operations directly from your AI tool using natural language, without navigating the CRM interface or working with APIs.
To get the list of available records from a module, or to get the details of a specific record with its unique record ID.
Learn how to request specific resources, fields of the resources and relationships of the resources in a single query.
